- **Mounting `useInboxBell` on Home, checked:** the hook fetches nothing itself, because the shared feeds own polling. Its arrival notifier keeps a module-scoped seen set, so a second mount announces nothing twice, as its docblock states. Home's own rows still come from `useHomeInbox`, and the unread pill drops when the feed re-reads (pinned by the new test).
